专车自驾/私人山岳向导带领徒步桑人岩画秘境与骑马赏花: Self-Drive by Private Car / Guided Hiking to San Rock Art Sites & Horseback Wildflower Viewing with Private Mountain Guide
丛林落叶渐疏视线变通透，清晨夜间转凉令大型动物活动时间明显拉长。: Jungle deciduous leaves gradually thin, making visibility crystal clear. Chilly mornings and nights noticeably extend the active hours of large wildlife.
东角高台（Eastern Head Viewpoint）驾车免费抵达；若想登上无: The Eastern Head Viewpoint is accessible by car free of charge; to ascend the Western Head Nature Reserve, which has no road connections, you must book the Featherbed Eco Experience ferry at the pier to reach the island.
两座国家公园全期入园税、社区生态捐献与向导小费: Full-term park entry fees for two national parks, community conservation donations, and guide tips
两百五十余株野生奇异箭袋树高高挺立在暗黑辉绿岩乱石岗间，银白色剥落树皮配对称分叉: More than 250 wild exotic quiver trees stand tall among the dark dolerite boulder fields, their silvery peeling bark paired with symmetrically branched green crowns. In winter, branches laden with yellow flowers beneath a starry silhouette look wonderfully otherworldly.
严禁向岩画喷水或触碰岩壁以免化学风化毁损；若体力充沛极推荐再徒步约1小时探访保存: Strictly do not spray water on rock art or touch the rock face to avoid chemical weathering damage; if you have high stamina, a hike of about 1 hour is highly recommended to visit the more vibrant and clearly preserved Nswatugi Cave rock paintings.
严禁无领队自驾强闯，海水涨潮极快极易吞没车辆；冲沙波谷起伏剧烈建议坐前排或备晕车: Strictly no self-driving through without a guide, as the incoming tide rises extremely fast and can easily engulf vehicles; dune valleys fluctuate violently so sitting in the front row or taking motion sickness medicine is recommended, and avoid changing camera lenses frequently in the blowing sand.
严禁用手指触碰岩画或喷水湿润画面拍照；步行往返近5公里且无遮荫，务必每人带足2升: Strictly do not touch the rock paintings with your fingers or wet the surfaces with water for photography; the round-trip walk is nearly 5 km with no shade, so be sure to bring at least 2 liters of water per person and prepare cash for the guide's tip in advance.
中长焦镜头、渐进灰滤镜、三脚架。: Telephoto/medium-telephoto lens, graduated neutral density filter, tripod.
主崖台无高护栏且阵风常急，拍摄广角悬崖全景注意脚下碎石稳立；峡谷边早晚温差极猛务: The main cliff edge has no high guardrails and gusty winds are frequent, so watch your footing on loose stones when framing wide-angle cliff panoramas; morning and evening temperature drops by the canyon are extremely sharp, so be sure to carry a windproof heavy jacket.
主木栈道（Foxy Beach）专供近距离安全观察企鹅而不会惊扰巢穴，严禁翻越栏: The main boardwalk (Foxy Beach) is dedicated to close-range, safe penguin viewing without disturbing nests; strictly do not cross the railings or use flash photography. To share a swim in the bay with the penguins, you can use same-day tickets to access the southern Boulders public beach section.
乌加布河漫长侵蚀后仅留一根高耸入云的三十五米红砂砾岩巨指孤立在红色平台中央，四周: After prolonged erosion by the Ugab River, only a single towering 35-meter red conglomerate monolith remains isolated in the center of the red plateau, surrounded by a broad wasteland valley resembling a miniature American Monument Valley.
乔贝公园、纳塔与恩赛门票及镇区特色简餐啤酒: Chobe Park, Nata, and Nsema entrance fees plus town-style light meals and beer
乔贝日落游船两趟、公园敞篷车晨猎 + 库布岛四驱过夜导览拼团: Two Chobe sunset cruises, park open-top vehicle morning safari + Kubu Island 4x4 overnight guided group tour
乔贝河中央受湿地泛滥滋养的肥沃绿洲草岛，必须由卡萨内码头乘坐河上游船环绕外围航道: A fertile oasis grass island in the middle of the Chobe River nourished by wetland floods; it must be observed by taking a river cruise from Kasane pier around the outer channels (no landing or walking on the island).
乔贝河岸天气舒适，南端马卡迪卡迪与猴面包树暗夜星轨清冷如洗。: The weather on the Chobe River bank is comfortable, and the starry night skies over Makgadikgadi and the baobabs in the south are as crisp and clear as wash.
乔贝私人摄影改装游船 + 四轮摩托穿越盐海夜宿星空床及驯化狐獴互动: Chobe Private Photographic Modified Cruise + Quad Biking Across the Salt Crust, Sleeping Under the Stars on a Star Bed & Interacting with Habituated Meerkats
乔贝金水渡河象群 × 库布岛纯白盐海阳光: Chobe Golden Water River-Crossing Elephants × Kubu Island Pristine White Salt Pan Sunshine
乘专业摄影船配备360度旋转万向云台座拍摄低机位水天线象群效果最震撼；从维多利亚: Board a professional photography boat equipped with a 360-degree universal gimbal seat to shoot low-vantage point water-horizon elephant herds for the most stunning visual impact; crossing from Victoria Falls to Kasane takes only about an hour by car, making combination itineraries very easy.
乘帆船出海奔赴巴扎鲁托岛 → 攀登百米金色大沙丘俯瞰玻璃泻湖: Take a sailing boat out to sea to Bazaruto Island → climb the 100-meter golden mega-dune for a bird's-eye view of the glass lagoon
乘车或转机抵托福海湾，清晨跟随认证生态潜船出海寻找温和鲸鲨和跃水座头鲸，下午漫步: Take a car or connecting flight to Tofo Bay, follow a certified eco-diving boat out at sea in the early morning to search for gentle whale sharks and breaching humpback whales, and spend the afternoon strolling through the laid-back African surf village.
乘马翁机场出发的拆门观光直升机或高翼轻型观光飞机，低空飞掠酋长岛南端与博罗河汇流: Take a door-off sightseeing helicopter or high-wing light sightseeing plane departing from Maun Airport, flying low over the fan-shaped wetland confluence at the southern end of Chief's Island and the Boro River.
于2x4终点停车场转乘公园官方四驱接驳车（约5公里深沙路段），或自驾高底盘四驱车: Transfer to the park's official 4x4 shuttle at the 2x4 end parking lot (about 5 km of deep sand tracks), or drive a high-clearance 4x4 with lowered tire pressure into the Sossusvlei main pan, then hike about 2 km to explore Deadvlei.
五十余段长达三十余米的远古松柏树干历经两亿八千万年火山灰深埋后完全硅化为坚硬玉石: Over 50 ancient conifer tree trunks, each over thirty meters long, were completely silicified into hard jade after being deeply buried in volcanic ash for 280 million years. Wood grain, insect bores, and even growth rings are razor-sharp and vivid, accompanied by naturally growing ancient Welwitschia mirabilis.
亿年断层坍塌与鱼河冲刷造就宽达二十七公里、深达五百五十米的巨型裂谷，蜿蜒河道在赤: Canyon carved by a billion-year fault collapse and the Fish River, creating a colossal gorge 27 kilometers wide and 550 meters deep. The winding river carves a breathtaking, semi-circular grand horseshoe bend amidst the reddish-brown Cambrian rock strata.
亿年玄武岩熔岩层叠出陡峭平顶高原，站在千六百米崖边俯瞰下方红褐色克利普河谷绵延向: Layers of billion-year-old basalt lava form steep flat-topped plateaus. Standing on the 1,600-meter cliff edge overlooking the reddish-brown Klip River valley below stretching toward the horizon, one occasionally spots Verreaux's eagles and desert elephant herds disappearing into the tree line at the valley floor.
仅两米宽的拱桥凌空架于百米深谷峭壁之上，右侧东瀑水帘如巨幕压迫近在咫尺，峡谷风卷: An arched bridge only two meters wide is suspended over a 100-meter-deep canyon precipice. To the right, the Eastern Cataract water curtain presses close like a giant screen, while canyon winds whip the waterfall spray upward to crash against the bridge railings, with rainbows circling right at your feet.
从 N2 拐入 R102 Groot River Pass 之字形原始森林峡谷公: Turn off N2 onto R102 Groot River Pass, descending the zigzagging primeval forest canyon road for about 15 minutes to reach an almost zero-commercialization lagoon white-sand beach.
从B2公路乌萨科斯西转D1918砂石路约30公里直达社区保护区大门，普通SUV慢: Turn west from B2 road at Usakos onto the D1918 gravel road for about 30 km straight to the community reserve gate; ordinary SUVs can drive slowly to park at the campsite at the foot of the rock arch.
从C39往东转入私人保护区砾石路约22公里直抵乌加布台地，非住客可在Vinger: Turn east from C39 onto the private reserve gravel road for about 22 km directly to the Ugab Terrace; non-guests can purchase day visitor passes at Vingerklip Lodge to drive the dirt track up to the stone pillar base.
从C40山口沿险峻陡坡发卡弯上行约3公里（强烈建议高底盘四驱车并挂低速四驱，或由: Climb about 3 km from the C40 mountain pass along steep hairpin bends on a precipitous slope (high-clearance 4x4 with low range strongly recommended, or take the camp shuttle from the parking point below).
从“法国小镇”弗朗斯胡克沿着 R45 悬崖山道向东盘旋而上约12分钟即达半山腰石: Wind your way up east from the 'French Hoek' of Franschhoek along the R45 cliff mountain road for about 12 minutes to reach the mid-mountain stone-built grand viewing platform.
从万基主营地向西南沿全天候红土路行驶约12公里直达双层原木高架观兽平台，普通轿车: Drive southwest from Hwange Main Camp along all-weather red-dirt roads for about 12 minutes straight to the double-tier log game-viewing platform, safely accessible even by ordinary sedans during the dry season.
从乌伊斯沿C35北转D2359砂石路抵达布兰德堡东麓山脚停车场，必须聘请景区持证: Turn north from Uis on C35 to D2359 gravel road to reach the parking lot at the eastern foot of the Brandberg; hiring a licensed local guide is mandatory to hike round-trip along the canyon riverbed for about 2 hours.
从哈拉里营地向东行驶约15公里沿环线南绕即达，周边植被较盐沼南岸更为繁茂，多硬质: Drive east from Haribes Camp for about 15 minutes along the southern loop to arrive; the surrounding vegetation is more lush than the southern salt pan shore, featuring mostly hard gravel roads.
从埃斯特科特向西驶入约1小时山道（部分碎石路段建议SUV或小心慢行）抵达人烟罕至: Drive west from Estcourt for about 1 hour of mountain roads (SUV or careful slow driving recommended for some gravel sections) to reach the remote Injisuthi Camp.
从塞斯瑞姆公园大门沿铺装路向西行驶45公里路南侧即设专用停车区，车位距沙丘坡脚仅: Drive 45 km west from the Sesriem Park Gate on the paved road; a dedicated parking area is located on the south side of the road, just over 100 meters from the foot of the dune slope, accessible directly by ordinary 2WD sedans.
从奈斯纳镇中心沿 George Rex Drive 驶向 The Heads 东: Drive from the Knysna town center along George Rex Drive toward The Heads eastern cliff, reaching multiple sea-cliff parking and viewing platforms in 10 minutes.
从奥卡库埃霍出发沿着西侧环盐沼砂石路北行约20公里即达水塘边停车土丘，紧挨西缘开: Drive north from Okaukuejo along the western salt-pan-loop gravel road for about 20 minutes to reach the waterhole parking mound, immediately adjacent to the open short-grass plains of the western edge.
从奥卡库埃霍或哈拉里走园内砂石环线向北延伸段即可驶入盐沼边缘法定观景泊车区（仅限: Drive onto the northern extension of the park's central Haribes loop from Okaukuejo or Haribes to enter the statutory viewing parking area on the edge of the salt pan (short driving permitted only on designated surfaces).
从市区沿 Kloof Nek 路前往 Tafelberg Road 下索道站，搭: Take Kloof Nek Road from the city center to the Tafelberg Road lower cable car station, and board the 360-degree rotating cable car for a roughly 5-minute ride to the summit; you can also hike up via Platteklip Gorge in 2–3 hours.
从开普敦北上约1,400公里往返高底盘SUV租车与油费分摊: Round-trip high-clearance SUV rental and fuel cost sharing for the ~1,400 km journey north from Cape Town
从斯瓦科普蒙德沿B2东行转C28向内陆行驶约40公里即可俯瞰月球谷，需在当地办公: Drive east from Swakopmund on the B2 and turn onto the C28 inland for about 40 minutes to overlook the Moon Landscape; you must purchase an environmental entry permit at the local office in advance before driving into the Welwitschia Drive loop.
从普莱滕贝格湾镇向南约15分钟车程到达 CapeNature 保护区门岗停车场，: Drive about 15 minutes south from Plettenberg Bay town to the CapeNature Reserve gate parking lot, choosing among the 2.1 km, 5.5 km, or 9.2 km loop trails based on your physical fitness level.
从死亡谷北侧入口起攀沙脊，沿S形主脊线一路踩沙上行约75至110分钟可达最高沙峰: Climb the sand ridge from the northern entrance of Deadvlei, following the S-shaped main ridge line up through the sand for about 75 to 110 minutes to reach the highest sand peak; on the way down, you can sandboard straight back down to the Deadvlei basin.
从水上视角仰望高出水面近700米的三茅屋峰垂直红绿绝壁，中景罕见的活体碳酸钙卡迪: Gaze upward from a water-level perspective at the vertical red-and-green sheer cliffs of the Three Rondavels rising nearly 700 meters above the water. In the mid-ground, the rare living Kadishi Tufa Waterfall drapes like a white silk curtain over mossy rock faces, with hippos and Nile crocodiles occasionally spotted in the water.
从津巴布韦侧维多利亚瀑布公园入口步行进湿润雨林步道，左行约5分钟直抵最西端的1号: Walk into the moist rainforest trail from the entrance of the Victoria Falls National Park in Zimbabwe, heading left for about 5 minutes directly to Viewpoints 1 and 2 at the westernmost end.
从老殖民首都松巴镇驱车盘山而上松巴高原顶面铺装林道，再沿土石林道向西南行驶至海拔: Drive up the winding paved forestry road to the summit of the Zomba Plateau from the old colonial capital of Zomba, then continue southwest along the dirt-and-stone forestry road to the edge of Chingwe's Hole at an altitude of nearly 2,000 meters.
从自由邦省 Witsieshoek Mountain Lodge 乘四驱摆渡车抵: Take the 4x4 shuttle from Witsieshoek Mountain Lodge in the Free State to Sentinel Car Park (approx. 2,550m), and climb to the plateau via a zigzag mountain path and two metal cliff chain ladders (approx. 12 km round-trip, 5–7 hours).
从赞比亚莫西奥图尼亚瀑布公园入口步行约15分钟即走上连接主陆与悬崖尖屿的悬空人行: Walk for about 15 minutes from the entrance of the Mosi-oa-Tunya National Park in Zambia onto the suspended concrete pedestrian narrow bridge connecting the mainland to the cliff islet.
从赫曼努斯向东南沿 R319 经布雷达斯多普约2小时抵达 L'Agulhas 镇: Drive southeast from Hermanus along the R319 via Bredasdorp for about 2 hours to L'Agulhas town, then walk 1 km along the boardwalk next to the red-and-white striped lighthouse to the southernmost monument.
从马拉维经济中心布兰太尔向东驱车约1.5小时穿过翠绿茶园抵达利库布拉森林站，雇持: Drive east from Blantyre, Malawi's economic center, for about 1.5 hours through emerald green tea estates to reach Likhubula Forest Station, hire licensed high-mountain porters and guides, and hike 4 to 6 hours up to the 2,000-meter plateau mountain chalet.
从马翁向西北驱车约35公里至博罗河水牛围栏以北湿地站（Mokoro Polers: Drive northwest from Maun for about 35 km to the wetland station north of the Boro River buffalo fence (Mokoro Polers Trust), and hire local polers to navigate the deep-water channels.
从鲸湾港口乘双体船巡航或皮划艇团划行接近沙咀，亦可乘四驱车沿盐田外沙堤向北行驶约: Cruise on a catamaran or paddle in a kayaking group from Walvis Bay harbor to approach the sandspit, or drive north along the salt pan outer dike in a 4x4 for about 40 minutes to reach the lighthouse outer beach.
伊哈哈岸晨猎 → 深入萨武提掠食者平原（或利尼扬蒂）: Ihaha Bank Morning Game Drive → Deep into Savuti Predator Plains (or Linyanti)
位于 V&A Waterfront 码头 Silo 区，市区乘车或 MyCiTi: Located in the Silo District of the V&A Waterfront, accessible in about 10 minutes by car or MyCiTi bus from the city center; open Tuesday to Sunday.
位于万基东南部森林草原过渡带（临近私营特许区边缘），由主营地向东南驰行约1.5小: Located in the woodland-savannah transition zone in the southeastern part of Hwange (near the edge of the private concession), easily accessible by driving southeast from the main camp for about 1.5 hours or by staying at a luxury wilderness camp outside the southeastern gate.
位于万基国家公园西北部玄武岩丘陵地带，自锡纳马泰拉山顶营地南下约22公里或从主营: Located in the basalt hill country in the northwestern part of Hwange National Park, reached by heading south for about 22 km from the Sinamatella hilltop camp or driving west across the park from the main camp for about 2.5 hours to the wooden two-story hide.
位于三角洲最北端水网腹地（NG23特许保护区），无公共公路联通，需从马翁或卡萨内: Located in the water network hinterland at the northernmost tip of the Delta (NG23 Concession), with no public road access; requires a light charter flight from Maun or Kasane to land at the Duba airstrip.
位于下萨比休息营（Lower Sabie Rest Camp）西北侧仅1公里处，: Located just 1 km northwest of Lower Sabie Rest Camp along the H4-1 riverside tar road (one of Kruger's most photographed routes), reaching the viewing dam bank.
位于下赞比西国家公园核心河岸内部，乘园区铝制快艇或加拿大双人轻舟划入主河道北侧狭: Located within the core riverside interior of Lower Zambezi National Park, accessed by taking park aluminum speedboats or Canadian tandem canoes into narrow shallow-water distributary channels on the north side of the main river (such as Chifungulu).
位于东部纳米托尼营地西南约12公里处，经迪克迪克环线岔路驶入，全段硬土砂石路面平: Located about 12 km southwest of Namutoni Camp in the east, accessed via the Dik-Dik Drive turnoff; the entire hard-packed dirt and gravel road surface is flat and very easy to drive.
位于乔贝公园西南部腹地，无任何铺装路可达，可由卡萨内乘四驱车沿深沙南行约4小时或: Located in the southwestern hinterland of Chobe Park with no paved roads leading to it; can be reached from Kasane by 4x4 driving south through deep sand for about 4 hours, or by flying from Maun/Kasane to the Savuti airstrip.
位于克鲁格中西部外缘并与园区全面贯通，从胡德斯普鲁特机场（HDS）乘车约40分钟: Located on the mid-western outer edge of Kruger with full integration into the park, about a 40-minute drive from Hoedspruit Airport (HDS) to private reserve camps like Kings Camp, Ngala, or Simbavati.
位于克鲁格最北端马库莱克保护区（Makuleke Concession），从帕福: Located in the Makuleke Concession at the northernmost tip of Kruger, entering and exiting via the Pafuri Gate; coming north from Skukuza in the south requires reserving a full day of driving (approx. 5–6+ hours), or fly via an inland regional route or stay at Pafuri Camp.
位于公园中西部安德森门以北17公里营地围栏旁，自驾可停于营地木屋步行3分钟抵达半: Located right beside the camp fence 17 km north of Anderson Gate in the west-central part of the park; self-drivers can park at the camp chalets and walk 3 minutes to the semicircular masonry game-viewing benches.
位于公园中部哈拉里营地西北小山丘石阶尽头，步行出营地房间约5分钟即达岩石露台坐席: Located at the end of the stone steps on a small hill northwest of Halali Camp in the central part of the park, about a 5-minute walk from camp rooms to the rock terrace seating.
位于北部莱索托 A1 高山公路沿线，距南非金门国家公园或 Fouriesburg: Located along the A1 alpine highway in northern Lesotho, about a 1.5-hour drive from South Africa's Golden Gate Highlands National Park or the Fouriesburg border post (entirely high-quality paved road, accessible by 2WD sedans).
位于南卢安瓜极少人烟的中部干沙河道，每年仅在6月至10月干季搭设季节性草棚徒步营: Located in the sparsely populated central dry sandy riverbed of South Luangwa, seasonal reed-mat walking camps are set up only during the dry season from June to October, about a 2-hour open-top vehicle drive north from Mfuwe.
位于博茨瓦纳最北端四国会合角小镇卡萨内西侧，沿铺装主干道驱车或直接从镇内码头登平: Located west of Kasane, a small town at the four-country junction at the northernmost tip of Botswana; drive along the paved main road or board a flat-bottom photography cruise boat directly from the town pier into the river channel.
位于卢安瓜河东岸相对独立的古老私营保护扇区，旱季经干河床或营地船只从主公园渡河抵: Located in a relatively independent ancient private conservation sector on the east bank of the Luangwa River, reached during the dry season across dry riverbeds or camp boats from the main park, retaining an extremely wild wilderness texture.
位于基特曼斯胡普东北约14公里的Gariganus私人农场内，沿M29砂石路直行: Located within the Gariganus private farm about 14 km northeast of Keetmanshoop, reaching the entrance registration office by driving straight along the M29 gravel road for about 20 minutes.
位于大陆伊尼亚索罗（Inhassoro）以东海面，从维兰库洛或伊尼亚索罗乘快艇约: Located in the sea east of Inhassoro on the mainland, accessed by taking a speedboat from Vilanculos or Inhassoro for a 30–50 minute day trip to the island.

位于桌山东麓斜坡，从市区沿 M3 向南约20分钟车程即达，园区设有多处停车场及咖: Located on the lower eastern slopes of Table Mountain, about a 20-minute drive south from the city center along the M3, with multiple parking lots, cafes, and restaurants within the park.

位于热带与亚热带印度洋暖流带全年绝对无雪，所谓6–8月“冬季”恰恰是大自然赐予的: Located in the tropical and subtropical Indian Ocean warm current belt, completely snow-free year-round. 位于纳马夸兰核心小城斯普林博克（Springbok）以东约15公里，普通车辆可行: Located about 15 km east of Springbok, the core small town of Namaqualand; ordinary vehicles can drive the 17 km floral loop and succulent nursery grounds.
位于苏丝斯黎以南约100公里（沿C27砂石路南行），需预订保护区内生态营地或参加: Located about 100 km south of Sossusvlei (driving south along the C27 gravel road), requiring reservations at an eco-camp within the reserve or joining a legal guided Tok Tokkie hiking excursion into the area.
位于莫桑比克极北德尔加杜角省（Cabo Delgado）外海，常规从彭巴（Pem: Located offshore in Cabo Delgado Province in the far north of Mozambique; typically accessed by taking a light regional charter flight directly from Pemba to the island airstrip or taking a designated ferry. 位于莫雷米保护区北部水道枢纽，可由三号木桥自驾东北行约1小时抵达船坞，或直接由飞: Located at the northern water channel hub of the Moremi Game Reserve, accessible by driving northeast from Third Bridge for about 1시간 to the boat dock, or taking an aluminum speedboat directly from fly-in camps.
位于莫雷米北门与夸伊保护区交界河岸，从马翁自驾经南门或从乔贝南下萨武提皆可沿土沙: Located on the riverbank at the border between Moremi North Gate and the Khwai Concession, accessible by dirt and sand tracks from Maun via the South Gate or heading south from Chobe to Savuti to reach the Khwai River bridge section.

位于莱索托最偏远的东南部高地，属于 UNESCO 乌卡兰巴-德拉肯斯堡世界遗产扩: Located in the most remote southeastern highlands of Lesotho, part of the UNESCO uKhahlamba-Drakensberg Park World Heritage extension; requires driving a hardcore 4x4 via Matatiele / Qacha's Nek or crossing the mountains on horseback from Bushman's Nek in South Africa.

位于马拉维湖东侧水域（被莫桑比克湖域包围的马拉维飞地），可乘每周固定航次的伊拉拉: Located in the eastern waters of Lake Malawi (a Malawian enclave surrounded by Mozambican waters); can be reached by overnight sailing aboard the scheduled weekly Ilala passenger steamer from Nkhata Bay, or by taking a small flight from Lilongwe.

位于马拉维湖南端南库姆巴半岛尖端（世界首个淡水国家公园），从首都利隆圭驾车东南行: Located at the tip of the Chembe Peninsula on the southern end of Lake Malawi (the world's first freshwater national park), reached by driving southeast from the capital Lilongwe for about 3.5 hours via Monkey Bay.

低海拔热带河谷终年无雪，6至7月黎明游猎敞篷车或乘早舟下河仍冷到需着羽绒服，温暖: The low-altitude tropical river valley is snow-free year-round. 全岛已被列入 UNESCO 世界文化遗产！岛北侧为石城遗迹，南侧为紧密活泼的本土: The entire island has been inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage site!
